name: Crazy Cubing in Christchurch 2025

venue.name: WEA Christchurch
venue.address: 59 Gloucester Street, Christchurch Central City, Christchurch 8013

information: Crazy Cubing in Christchurch 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
